data.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (f/m/d)
Quality Control Manager
data.description:
We are looking for a Quality Control Manager to establish and lead the company-wide quality-control process across production, operations, engineering, testing, and support functions.

You will define how quality is measured, verified, documented, and improved across the company. Working closely with subject-matter experts in highly technical departments—including propulsion—you will build practical quality-control processes that support rapid development while maintaining high standards of safety, reliability, traceability, and performance.

This is a broad, hands-on role for someone who can create structure in a fast-moving technical environment, create scalable, low friction and effective processes - working effectively with both production teams and specialist engineers.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and implement company-wide quality-control processes covering production, operations, engineering, testing, and technical support activities.

  • Define inspection plans, acceptance criteria, test requirements, quality records, traceability expectations, and release processes.

  • Work with subject-matter experts to develop practical quality controls for complex technical systems, materials, hardware, and processes.

  • Lead the management of non-conformances, deviations, defects, corrective actions, and recurring quality issues.

  • Develop quality metrics and reporting to identify trends, process variation, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Train and support teams in quality-control procedures while continuously improving the company’s quality culture and working practices.

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience in quality control, quality engineering, manufacturing quality, or a similar role within a complex technical organisation.

  • Proven experience establishing or improving quality-control processes across production, operations, engineering, or testing functions.

  • Strong understanding of inspection, testing, measurement, process control, traceability, documentation, and non-conformance management.

  • The ability to work confidently with technical specialists and translate complex requirements into clear, usable quality processes.

  • Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills, with a practical approach to improving quality without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • A degree or equivalent professional experience in engineering, manufacturing, quality management, science, or a related discipline.

Desirable experience

  • Quality control within aerospace, defence, space, automotive, energy, medical, or another high-reliability industry.

  • Experience working with complex hardware, specialist materials, hazardous processes, safety-critical systems, or regulated production environments.

  • Familiarity with quality-management systems, internal audits, configuration control, change management, and process qualification.

  • Experience with root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, statistical process control, capability studies, or measurement-system analysis.

  • Experience with supplier quality, incoming inspection, calibration, material certification, or production release.

  • Experience building quality processes in an early-stage, rapidly scaling, or vertically integrated organisation.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

 

Compensation: €75K – €90K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

data.title: Construction Manager
data.description:
We are looking for an experienced Construction Manager to oversee the delivery of a wide range of complex construction and infrastructure projects across our site. These projects will range from small propulsion test stands and supporting facilities through to the larger infrastructure required to manufacture and assemble our orbital launch vehicle, and the propellant to operate it.

This is a highly varied role involving technical, commercial, operational, and stakeholder-management responsibilities. You will work with architects, engineers, contractors, suppliers, government officials, and internal teams to deliver complex facilities safely, efficiently, and to the required standard.

While we dont expect previous experience in rocketry, the ideal candidate will have proven experience managing construction programmes industrial military or high energy sectors, or other high-reliability environment. Fluency in German is essential.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the planning and delivery of multiple construction and infrastructure projects across the company’s site.

  • Coordinate architects, engineers, contractors, suppliers, internal stakeholders, and government officials.

  • Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, contracts, risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones.

  • Lead the development and review of designs, construction plans, permits, method statements, and project documentation.

  • Ensure construction activities meet required standards for safety, quality, reliability, security, and operational suitability.

  • Oversee commissioning, handover, and close-out activities to ensure facilities are ready for manufacturing, assembly, testing, and operations.

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience managing complex construction programmes in an industrial, aerospace, defence, manufacturing, energy, or other high-reliability environment.

  • Proven experience delivering projects from early definition and design through construction, commissioning, and handover.

  • Strong understanding of construction planning, contractor management, commercial control, risk management, and project governance.

  • Experience working with architects, engineering consultants, construction companies, regulators, local authorities, and government stakeholders.

  • Fluent German, with the ability to communicate confidently with local stakeholders, contractors, authorities, and project partners.

  • A degree or equivalent professional experience in construction management, civil engineering, structural engineering, project management, or a related discipline.

Desirable experience

  • Industrial facilities in high energy or military sectors such as aerospace infrastructure, launch sites, test facilities, manufacturing plants, or high-reliability production environments.

  • Construction or commissioning of test stands, hazardous-process facilities, clean areas, workshops, utilities, or specialist engineering infrastructure.

  • Experience working within regulated environments involving hazardous materials, explosives, high-energy systems, or demanding safety requirements.

  • Experience managing design changes, construction variations, procurement packages, contractor claims, and commercial negotiations.

  • Familiarity with construction contracts, permitting, planning approvals, environmental requirements, and German construction regulations.

  • Experience supporting the rapid development of facilities within an early-stage or fast-growing company.

data.title: Lead Flight Software Engineer
data.description:
This is a unique opportunity to lead the development of the software that makes our rockets fly. We are looking for a highly capable Lead Flight Software Engineer to own the architecture, development, verification, and integration of software across the vehicle and ground segment.

From low-level embedded software controlling propulsion systems and flight hardware to flight-computer routines, telemetry, telecommand, and ground-support infrastructure, your work will be critical to launch success. You will provide technical leadership while remaining hands-on across the software stack and supporting real hardware campaigns.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the technical direction and architecture of the flight-software platform across embedded, real-time, and ground-segment systems.

  • Lead the development of deterministic software for propulsion systems, flight computers, avionics, sensors, and other vehicle hardware.

  • Define software requirements, interfaces, design documentation, development standards, and verification strategies.

  • Develop and maintain ground software, embedded test tools, telemetry and telecommand processing, and data-distribution systems.

  • Work closely with avionics, propulsion, systems, and AIT teams to integrate, test, debug, and validate software on real hardware.

  • Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and software support during vehicle and test campaigns.

What we are looking for

  • Significant professional experience developing embedded, flight, or real-time software for aerospace, defence, robotics, automotive, or another safety-critical hardware environment.

  • High proficiency in C or C++ for resource-constrained and real-time systems.

  • Direct experience with real-time operating systems, embedded Linux, or comparable low-level software environments.

  • Strong understanding of hardware interfaces, network programming, TCP/IP, UDP, and data serialisation.

  • A disciplined approach to deterministic execution, fault handling, testing, debugging, and software verification.

  • A degree in computer science, aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

Desirable experience

  • Flight software for launch vehicles, spacecraft, aircraft, missiles, or other complex aerospace systems.

  • Hardware abstraction layers, board-support packages, low-level drivers, avionics interfaces, or flight-computer development.

  • Telemetry and telecommand systems, packet processing, data buses, ground stations, or mission-control software.

  • Hardware-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, automated testing, or formal verification and validation.

  • Python or similar languages for test automation, tooling, data analysis, and ground-support software.

  • Supporting live hardware campaigns, launch operations, static-fire tests, or vehicle integration activities.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

data.title: Full Stack Developer (m/w/d) | KI & LegalTech
data.description:
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der KI-gestützten Rechtsberatung
fairforce ist der LegalTech-Pionier mit Sitz in Leipzig. Seit 2017 digitalisieren wir Rechtsdienstleistung für Verbraucher und globale Brands. Unser Team wächst – und damit auch unsere Architektur. Um unsere Deployment-Frequenz zu erhöhen, suchen wir eine erfahrene Verstärkung mit hands-on Mentalität, Überblick und review-Kompetenz.

Aufgaben

  • Qualität & Gatekeeping
    Du unterstützt unseren Team-Lead bei Code-Reviews und Testautomatisierungen und stellst durch hohe Standards sicher, dass Tickets effizient und sicher gemergt werden können.

  • Data-Handling
    Unsere über neun Jahre gewachsene MariaDB hat wertvolle Daten – Du optimierst Abfragen und verstehst die Logik hinter komplexen Datenstrukturen.

  • End-to-End Verantwortung
    Nach dem Motto „You build it, you run it“ begleitest Du Features vom ersten Konzept bis zum Rollout.

KI & Backend-Engineering (Real-World Implementation)

  • Prompt Engineering & Output Control
    Du optimierst Prompts für die Extraktion aus unstrukturierten juristischen Dokumenten und stellst durch Validierungsschichten (Guardrails) sicher, dass die KI-Ergebnisse verlässlich in die MariaDB zurückfließen.

  • Actionable Insights
    Du entwickelst Logiken, die aus extrahierten Daten nicht nur Informationen gewinnen, sondern automatisiert präzise Antwortentwürfe und prozessrelevante Folge-Tasks (To-dos) ableiten.

  • AI-Driven Development
    Du nutzt selbst modernste KI-Tools (z. B. Claude/Anthropic, Copilot), um Deine Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit zu maximieren, und unterstützt das Team dabei, diese Tools effizient in den SDLC zu integrieren.

Qualifikation

Das brauchst Du bei fairforce:

  • Erfahrung
    Mindestens 5 Jahre professionelle Full-Stack-Erfahrung. Du hast bereits in Umgebungen gearbeitet, in denen Code-Qualität und Review-Prozesse entscheidend waren.

  • Tech-Stack
    Du beherrscht Java / Spring Boot und bist ebenso sicher in React mit TypeScript.

  • Datenbank Know-How
    Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken (MariaDB/MySQL) und weißt, wie man in großen Tabellen-Strukturen performant arbeitet.

  • Architectural Mindset
    Du denkst in skalierbaren Microservices und sauberen Schnittstellen (REST).

  • Sprache
    Deutsch beherrschst Du fließend (C1/C2), um Dich in der komplexen Legal-Domäne sicher zu bewegen. Die Erfahrung hat gezeigt, wie wichtig das sprachliche Verständnis für die gemeinsame Entwicklung wirklich ist.

Benefits

Das bekommst Du bei fairforce:

  • überdurchschnittliche und sichere Vergütung

  • 28 Tage Urlaub + bezahlte Bildungstage

  • betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • vermögenswirksame Leistungen bis zu 480 € p.a.

  • steuerfreier Sachbezug bis zu 600 € p.a.

  • Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung / Kindergartenzuschuss

  • Jobrad /Jobticket

  • Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio in Leipzig Plagwitz

  • Dein Arbeitsplatz im Grünen mit Blick auf den Karl-Heine-Kanal.
    Ausgestattet mit Profiküche und Dachterrasse

  • flexible Arbeitsplatzgestaltung durch ergonomische Stühle und höhenverstellbare Tische, top-moderne Rechner, Monitore und Zubehör

  • performanter Laptop und Zugänge zu mächtigen KI-Werkzeugen

  • sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung (S-Bahn, Straßenbahn, Bus, Fahrradparkplätze)

  • Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und vielfältige Gastronomie fußläufig erreichbar

  • ein interdisziplinäres Team (34 Köpfe) , das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und wertschätzt

  • einfache und gerechte Arbeitszeiterfassung mit praktischen Gutschrift-Optionen

  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit

  • Firmenevents (Vorträge, Grillen, Kochen, Boot fahren, Filmabend, Weihnachts- und Sommerfest…)

  • Getränke-Flatrate (Kaffee/Tee/Wasser)

  • mittwochs Team-Pizza

  • geförderte Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • für Deinen perfekten Start:
